metadata.title: Pendek — URL Shortener
metadata.description: Turn long URLs into short links that are easy to copy and share.

workspace.title: Short links
workspace.sessionHelp: Up to six links created while this page is open. Switching pages clears this list.

hero.description: Turn long URLs into short links that are easy to copy, send, and share.
hero.illustration: Illustration of a long URL becoming a short link

form.heading: Create a short link
form.label: Destination URL
form.help: Use a complete address starting with https:// or http://.
form.empty: Your short link will appear here.
form.recentHelp: Created while this page is open.

result.ready: Your short link is ready to share.
result.copyFailure: Could not copy. Select the link address and copy it manually.

steps.title: Paste a URL
steps.description: Copy the address of the page you want to share.

steps.title: Create a short link
steps.description: We save the destination and create a unique code for your link.

steps.title: Copy and share
steps.description: Anyone who opens the link will be redirected to the destination page.

footer.privacy: Only share URLs that may be accessed publicly.

notFound.title: Page not found.
notFound.description: Check the address you opened or create a new short link.

redirect.notFound: Link not found. Check the address or ask the sender for a new link.
redirect.unavailable: This link cannot be opened right now. The service is unavailable; please try again later.

auth.loginDescription: Sign in to create and manage your own links.
auth.registerDescription: Keep your links in a personal dashboard with your email account.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to finish registering, then open the confirmation link in the same browser. If you already have an account, sign in instead.
auth.confirmationFailed: The confirmation link is invalid or expired. Sign in if your email is already confirmed, or try registering again.
auth.publicNote: Links on this page are created without an account. Use the dashboard to save and manage your own links.

dashboard.visitsHelp: Repeat opens, bots, and previews count. Totals include saved links on every page. Refresh to update.
dashboard.creatorHelp: New links will appear in the saved links list.
dashboard.title: My links.
dashboard.description: Create, copy, and manage your own links in one place.
dashboard.empty: No saved links yet. Create your first link using the form beside or above this list.
dashboard.deleteConfirm: Delete link {code}? This short link will stop working.
dashboard.unavailable: The dashboard cannot be loaded right now. Please try again later.

alias.label: Custom alias (optional)
alias.help: Leave empty for an automatic code. Use 3–32 letters, digits, - or _. Uppercase and lowercase are different.

errors.aliasInvalid: Use 3–32 letters, digits, hyphens (-) or underscores (_) for the alias.
errors.aliasTaken: This alias is already taken. Choose another alias or leave it empty for an automatic code.
errors.required: Enter the URL you want to shorten.
errors.tooLong: URLs must be at most 2,048 characters long.
errors.protocol: Use a complete URL starting with https:// or http://.
errors.invalidUrl: This URL is not valid. Check the address and try again.
errors.credentials: Use a URL without a username or password in the address.
errors.shortLink: Enter the original destination URL, rather than a short link from this app.
errors.bodyTooLarge: The request is too large. URLs must be at most 2,048 characters long.
errors.invalidJson: The request is not valid. Send the URL in JSON format.
errors.origin: The request must come from this application.
errors.contentType: Send the request with Content-Type application/json.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.unavailable: The link could not be created. The service is unavailable; please try again later.
errors.connection: The connection was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
errors.authFields: Enter a valid email address and password.
errors.invalidRequest: The request data is invalid or too large. Check the data and try again.
errors.authPassword: Enter a password; new accounts require 8–128 characters.
errors.authInvalid: The email/password is incorrect, or the email has not been confirmed.
errors.authRequired: Sign in first to manage your own links.
errors.authUnavailable: The account service is unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.authRegistration: The account could not be registered. Check your email and password and try again.
errors.authRateLimit: Too many account attempts. Please try again later.
errors.linkMissing: The link was not found or cannot be accessed by this account.
errors.dashboardUnavailable: Saved links cannot be loaded right now. Please try again later.
errors.deleteFailed: The link could not be deleted. Please try again later.
